subject: POC kickoff with Acme Insights - next steps & trial access
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmeinsights.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeinsights.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps and access

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call today — really appreciate the context on your ingestion pipeline and the latency targets for the insights UI. As discussed, next steps to get the POC started: 

1) I'll provision a trial environment scoped to the models we discussed (small quantized variants) and invite your engineering lead.
2) I'll attach a short onboarding checklist for the kickoff and propose a 45-minute kickoff session to walk through environment, dataset ingestion, and acceptance criteria.
3) Please confirm the primary contact for the setup (engineer who will run the workload) and a preferred window next week for the kickoff.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and a short trial access doc. Rafael is looped in to help with infra and model alignment.

Output: Goal is to have a working inference path and sample dashboard within two weeks so you can validate latency and throughput.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-poc-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, trial-access-instructions.txt

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmeinsights.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeinsights.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps and access

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Priya will be the primary contact for setup (she's cc'd). We're available for a kickoff on Thursday 10am PT or Friday 2pm PT. Which works best for you?

Quick questions before the kickoff:
- Any bandwidth constraints we should know about for the trial env (max concurrent requests)?
- Do we need to share a sample dataset ahead of time and if so, what's the preferred format?

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Product, Acme Insights

(On a related note, I'm copying our security lead if we end up needing an NDA or security questionnaire)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmeinsights.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeinsights.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps and access

Thanks — Thursday 10am PT works for our team. 

- Bandwidth: for the trial environment we'll provide a small dedicated pool tuned for your expected concurrency (you won't hit hard limits during validation), and we'll share expected qps once we provision.
- Dataset: a small sample (<= 1000 rows) in CSV or JSONL is perfect; we'll give a template in the kickoff.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 10am PT and include a short agenda (ingest, infra, acceptance criteria). Rafael will provision the environment later today and you'll receive credentials and the trial instructions attachment.

See you Thursday — Marissa

Subject: Redwood trial environment provisioned

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Environment's live: I've provisioned a trial cluster (small dedicated pool) and created a service account for Acme Insights. Credentials and a step-by-step guide are in the secure note I just shared (you should receive an email with one-time credentials).

Next steps for kickoff:
- Use the service account to push a sample dataset (CSV/JSONL) to the ingestion endpoint.
- Run the sample inference job; if you hit any errors ping me directly and I'll jump in.

I'm standing by for the Thu 10am kickoff but noticed we haven't received the sample dataset yet. If you need to move the kickoff, let me know otherwise we'll keep the slot.

Best,
Rafael
Solution Engineer | Redwood Inference

(attachment: trial-access-instructions.txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeinsights.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmeinsights.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — POC kickoff / dataset / priority

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Bumping this thread — we ran the provisioning on July 2 and haven't seen any activity from Acme on the trial environment. Wanted to check: is this still a priority for your team? If timing shifted, totally understand — we can pause the environment and rebook a kickoff when it's higher priority.

If you are still proceeding, quick asks:
- Can you upload a 100–500 row sample (CSV or JSONL) to the ingestion endpoint so we can validate latency?
- If you need help, Rafael can do a 30-minute screen share and complete the ingestion for you.

If you'd prefer a later kickoff window, propose 07/21 or 07/28 and we'll book it.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
